ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) base surface with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution concentrated in localized spots and distal clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity clusters localized at distal tips (barnacles). Frequent small-scale (<15px) high-intensity circular points distributed across the inner-to-mid lobe surfaces. A larger high-intensity amorphous cluster is visible on the inner-upper quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the center-point with a calculated angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The left lobe exhibits fine-grain serration with low pixel-amplitude variations. The right lobe exhibits high-amplitude macro-serration and irregular pixel-depth voids (jagged profile) between the notch and distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve transitioning to a sharp convex upward trajectory at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial distribution of circular white rings and solid white spots (barnacle scars) across the entire ventral area of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct set of parallel, diagonal high-contrast lines (rake marks) positioned on the dorsal-ventral transition area of the right lobe near the upper-middle edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and jagged indentations along the trailing edge of the right lobe, indicating historical physical trauma or predation marks.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense 3D calcified clusters (live barnacles) visible at the outer terminal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
